messages:
deploy-bot: Candidate ready for promotion: rc-2026-042 (build bfb3c). artifact: s3://redwood-artifacts/rc-2026-042.tar.gz. Change window 2026-03-20 22:00-23:00 UTC. Planned rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks. Need sign-off from @mei, @sre-lucy, @qa-jen. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/rc-2026-042

mei: quick staging smoke done, perf looks ok. found minor tokenizer ordering diff for model redwood-1.4.2 but outputs semantically same. running full eval suite now, ETA ~15m.

qa-jen: kicking off regression run for "conversational-core" prompt set. will report any fails.

sre-lucy: checking infra headroom and autoscale. GPU pool has spare capacity for canary. I'll add watchers: gpu-util, per-token p95/p99, 5xx rate. ETA 10m.

sanjay: request: pin exact model version to avoid automatic fallback to quantized variant during canary. Please pin redwood-1.4.2-rc42 for this rollout.

deploy-bot: /pin applied: model=redwood-1.4.2-rc42 pinned to cohort=rc-1910203040 by sanjay

mei: evals passed besides the tokenizer note, no semantic regressions. adding a one-line note in release notes.

product-dan: reviewed release notes, no customer-facing behavior changes called out except perf improvements. OK from product.

sre-lucy: Proposed rollout checklist:
```
1) 2% traffic -> wait 5m -> check: 5xx < 1% and p99 < 200ms
2) if ok -> 10% -> wait 10m -> check same
3) if ok -> 50% -> wait 20m
4) if ok -> 100% and finalize
Rollback triggers: sustained >1.5% 5xx over 5m OR p99 > 500ms for 10m.
Escalation: ping @sre-lucy -> @eng-oncall -> on-call rotation.```

qa-jen: regression completed: 0 failures on conversational-core. attaching short logs: `regression-pass-191020.log`

alex: All green from eng side. Approving rollout. /promote when ready. cc @ops-bot

ops-bot: Promotion scheduled, waiting final sign-off from @sre-lucy

sre-lucy: Sign-off given. I'll be on watch for the first 30m. Go for canary.

alex: /promote rc-2026-042 -> prod-canary now

deploy-bot: Promotion started: canary traffic 2%. healthcheck endpoint: https://telemetry.redwood/status/rc-2026-042. Watch logs: https://logs.redwood/rc-2026-042/canary

sre-lucy: seeing expected traffic, 5xx=0.02%, p99=142ms. No anomalies so far.

(30m later) deploy-bot: Canary progression complete: 100% traffic rolled. Promotion finished successfully. Pin remains until EOD for quick rollback window. Release notes published: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/rc-2026-042.

alex: thanks everyone. will remove pin tomorrow morning after no regressions observed. :tada:
